description: Generate realistic mock data: names, emails, addresses, dates, UUIDs, phone numbers, company names, credit cards (fake), IP addresses. Configurable count and locale.

count.description: Number of items to generate (default: 10, max: 1000)

type.description: Type of data to generate: name, email, address, date, uuid, phone, company, credit_card, ip

types.description: Generate mixed records with multiple field types (alternative to single type). Each record will have all specified fields.

name: generate_mock_data
